    25	divisor equations, and the pullback-stable presentation locus are present. The conditional

    28	missing. The native evaluation section and the tied datum section now have the same restriction-
    29	vanishing predicate on every open, without a Noetherian hypothesis. Their piece coordinates and
    30	principal piece ideals agree, and those native-coordinate ideals commute with arbitrary affine
    31	coefficient extension. Identifying the resulting intrinsic zero locus with the datum local
    32	equations and gluing the piecewise ideals to a family divisor are still missing. The tied datum
    33	section is coherent along arbitrary affine coefficient towers, and local evaluation divisors cut
    34	by two generators agree on their pairwise product open. Comparing these local divisors with
    35	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` after coefficient change, and then gluing them, are still missing. The
    36	resulting family-level divisor producer is not claimed.

    39	translator degree and the exact subtraction compatibility tied to one result. It does not

    41	Abel isomorphism, separably closed cover, later representability/descent endpoints, and

    75	/-- The general per-field translated rank-one producer in the `Pic^0` indexing required by the
    76	separably closed cover.
    77	
    78	The output is the existing lambda-tied data/result pair.  Its first conclusion says that the
    79	base-field translator has degree `genus C`; its second conclusion makes the precise
    80	finite-support/residue-one/base-subtraction compatibility available; and its last conclusion is
    81	the existing rank-one-layer `IsSplitWitness`.  Thus this is a specialization and immediate
    82	consumer of the general producer, not a fieldwise replacement for `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    83	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_pic0
    84	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
    85	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    86	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    87	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
    88	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
    89	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d),
    90	      classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) ∧
    91	        (Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    92	            x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
    93	          (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
    94	              x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
    95	            p ∈ r.S.support →
    96	              (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
    97	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
    98	            Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
    99	              ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹)) ∧
   100	        IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).1 := by

    98	The underlying class is the result's translated input, and the subtype proof is computed from
    99	the residual class `W₀ - S`.  Thus the output is directly an element of the `picDegLayer` target
   100	used by `PicRankOneOpen`, rather than a parallel existential carrier. -/
   101	noncomputable def SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer
   102	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   103	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   104	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
   105	    picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K) := by
   106	  let translated : picEt C (overSpec k K) := mu * thetaFamily C
   107	    (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)
   108	  have hgenusInt : (d.genusValue : ℤ) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   109	    have hchiC := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   110	    linarith [d.hχ]
   111	  have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   112	  have hSZ := r.baseClass
   113	  have hW :
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
   115	        d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   116	          (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) := by
   117	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   118	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   119	      Scheme.picClass_neg, hW₀, hSZ]
   120	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   121	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   122	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero,
   123	      inv_one, mul_one, pow_zero, one_mul]
   124	  have hpresentation :=
   125	    picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit
   126	      C mu d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.m r.Z
   127	  have hdegreeAtId :
   128	      degAt translated (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   129	    unfold translated degAt
   130	    rw [picEtMap_id]
   131	    rw [← classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ _ hpresentation]
   132	    rw [← hW, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg,
   133	      r.degree, hgenusInt]
   134	    ring
   135	  refine ⟨translated, ?_⟩
   136	  intro K' _ _ t
   137	  rw [degAt_eq_degAt_id_of_overSpec]

    50	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    51	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    52	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    53	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    54	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    55	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
    56	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
    57	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by

    77	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    78	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    79	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))

    11	
    12	/-!
    13	# Native presentations for split field classes
    14	
    15	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension.
    16	For each such extension, the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its own arbitrary-ring
    17	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
    18	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation`.
    19	
    20	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
    21	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	
    41	noncomputable section
    42	
    43	/-- The arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has a complete native presentation.
    44	
    45	The datum is the representative extracted from the displayed pullback `lam`.  Its residue-field
    46	H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
    47	Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
    48	cocycle datum. -/
    49	theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
    50	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    51	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    52	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    53	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    54	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    55	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
    56	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
    57	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
    58	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
    59	  let cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates P.datum :=
    60	    RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi
    61	      (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)
    62	      (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L)
    63	  refine ⟨PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates
    64	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class ?_ cert⟩
    65	  intro T' X' g f' g' sq
    66	  exact P.datum.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule
    67	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr cert.h1_vanishing)
    68	    g f' g' sq
    69	
    70	/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.
    71	
    72	Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
    73	preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
    74	-/
    75	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
    76	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    77	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    78	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    79	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
    80	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
    81	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
    82	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
    83	  intro A _ _ t
    84	  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom (k := k) K A t
    85	  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
    86	    (C := C) hpi e lam.1 rfl hsplit
    87	
    88	end
    89	
    90	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Field-extension stability for rank-one presentation witnesses
    11	
    12	The rank-one layer delivered by the translated-cover construction is a class over a field.
    13	Testing its pullback over an arbitrary affine algebra reads that class at residue fields, which
    14	are arbitrary extensions of the original field.  This file proves that the split-witness
    15	condition survives every such extension.
    16	
    17	The proof does not reuse the original splitting field directly.  If `N / K` is the finite
    18	separable splitting supplied by the witness and `L / K` is arbitrary, a field factor `P / L`
    19	of `L \otimes[K] N` is finite separable over `L` and receives `N`.  The presenting Cech class
    20	and its `H^1` witness are then transported from `N` to `P`.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	open AlgebraicJacobian

    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

    43	noncomputable section
    44	
    45	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    46	-- Constructing and transporting through a field factor of `L ⊗[K] N` needs the larger budget.
    47	/-- A split witness remains a split witness after an arbitrary extension of its reading field.
    48	
    49	The output splitting field is not the original one: it is a finite-separable field factor of
    50	the base change of the original field cover.  Consequently no finiteness, separability, or
    51	algebraicity assumption is imposed on the reading-field extension itself.  The auxiliary finite
    52	map `pi` is used only to choose a basic-open cocycle datum through which the `H¹` witness is
    53	transported. -/
    54	theorem isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom
    55	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    56	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    57	    (e : K →ₐ[k] L) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    58	    (h : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
    59	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu) := by
    60	  obtain ⟨N, hNf, hkN, hKN, htowkKN, hNfin, hNsep, M, hM, W, hW, hW1⟩ := h
    61	  letI := hNf
    62	  letI := hkN
    63	  letI := hKN
    64	  letI := htowkKN
    65	  letI := hNfin
    66	  letI := hNsep
    67	  letI hKL : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    68	  haveI htowkKL : IsScalarTower k K L :=
    69	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (e.commutes x).symm
    70	  obtain ⟨P, hPf, hLP, hPfin, hPsep, ⟨q⟩⟩ :=
    71	    ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) N).baseChange L).exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
    72	  letI := hPf
    73	  letI := hLP
    74	  letI := hPfin
    75	  letI := hPsep
    76	  letI hkP : Algebra k P := ((algebraMap L P).comp (algebraMap k L)).toAlgebra
    77	  haveI htowkLP : IsScalarTower k L P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    78	  letI hKP : Algebra K P := ((algebraMap L P).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    79	  haveI htowKLP : IsScalarTower K L P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    80	  haveI htowkKP : IsScalarTower k K P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    81	    change algebraMap L P (algebraMap k L x) = algebraMap L P (e (algebraMap k K x))
    82	    rw [e.commutes]

    12	/-!
    13	# Native rank-one certificates for the lambda-tied datum
    14	
    15	This file closes the Picard-side consumer boundary.  A `PicRankOneNativeDatum` already records
    16	that its etale representative presents the displayed lambda and that its basic-open cocycle datum
    17	represents that same relative Picard class.  Residue-field split witnesses therefore produce the
    18	four cohomological certificates for this exact datum over its arbitrary affine coefficient ring.
    19	
    20	The returned package uses the canonical `h0BaseChange` and `scalarExtension` operations from
    21	`RankOneFamilyCertificates`; `h0BaseChange_tower` proves their coherence along every affine
    22	coefficient tower.  The final constructor passes the package directly to
    23	`PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    43	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    44	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    45	
    46	namespace PicRankOneNativeDatum
    47	
    48	/-- The pointwise split condition on the displayed lambda representative carried by `P`. -/
    49	abbrev ResidueSplitWitnesses (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam) : Prop :=
    50	  ∀ t : (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left,
    51	    IsSplitWitness C
    52	      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
    53	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
    54	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))))
    55	
    56	/-- Produce the complete arbitrary-affine certificate package for the lambda-tied datum `P`.
    57	
    58	The H1 input is converted from split witnesses for `P.representative`; the degree law is derived
    59	from `P.represents` and `P.datum_class`.  Finiteness and projectivity are constructed at a genuine
    60	finite Noetherian stage and transported back, rather than supplied by the caller. -/
    61	noncomputable def familyCertificates
    62	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    63	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    64	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses) :
    65	    RankOneFamilyCertificates P.datum :=
    66	  RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi
    67	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness hsplit)
    68	    (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L)
    69	
    70	/-- Canonically extend the lambda-tied certificate package to any affine coefficient algebra. -/
    71	noncomputable def familyCertificatesBaseChange
    72	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    73	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    74	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    75	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    76	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    77	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (P.datum.baseChange B) :=
    78	  (P.familyCertificates hpi hsplit).scalarExtension B
    79	
    80	end PicRankOneNativeDatum
    81	
    82	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    83	
    84	/-- Assemble a native rank-one presentation from the actual lambda-tied datum and its split
    85	witnesses.  The only remaining independent input is the native pushforward base-change theorem. -/
    86	noncomputable def ofNativeDatum
    87	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    88	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    89	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    90	    (hpush :
    91	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    92	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    93	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    94	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    95	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g),
    96	        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.datum.nativeModule)) :
    97	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    98	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates
    99	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class hpush
   100	      (P.familyCertificates hpi hsplit)
   101	
   102	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   103	
   104	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- Assemble a native rank-one presentation directly from the family
certificates.  The arbitrary-cartesian base-change field is supplied by
`isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule`, rather than accepted as an
additional certificate. -/
noncomputable def ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    (x : descentClasses C E)
    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    (hclass :
      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
    (cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
  ofCertificates E x hrep D hclass
    (fun g f' g' sq ↦
      D.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule
        ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr cert.h1_vanishing)
        g f' g' sq)
    cert

end PicRankOneNativePresentation

private noncomputable def pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (eq : h = f ≫ g) (N : Z.Modules) :
    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj N, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N, ⊤) := by
  let sheafIso := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eq).app N ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).symm.app N
  let topAdd : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj N, ⊤) ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N, ⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.hom ⊤).hom x
      invFun := fun x ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.inv ⊤).hom x
      left_inv := fun x ↦ by
        simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
          sheafIso.hom_inv_id, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      right_inv := fun x ↦ by
        simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
          sheafIso.inv_hom_id, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      map_add' := fun x y ↦
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.hom ⊤).hom.map_add x y }
  exact topAdd.toLinearEquiv (fun r x ↦
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul sheafIso.hom r x)

private lemma pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv_baseMap
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (eq : h = f ≫ g) (N : Z.Modules)
    {V : Y.Opens} {W : Z.Opens}
    (eV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (eT : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (eTW : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ W) (x : Γ(N, W)) :
    pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv f g h eq N
        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap h N eTW x) =
      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap f
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N) eT
          (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g N eV x) := by
  apply (asIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) ⊤)).toEquiv.injective
  change (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) ⊤).hom
        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app N) ⊤).hom
          ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eq).hom.app N) ⊤).hom
            (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap h N eTW x))) = _
  rw [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
    AddCommGrpCat.hom_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  rw [pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_congr eq N eTW
    (eT.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f eV)) x]
  exact (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_comp f g N eV eT
    (eT.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f eV)) x).symm

end
